title: SEO and GEO Agency for Dubai Businesses | 22 Signals
description: SEO and GEO for Dubai businesses: rank in Google for English and Arabic searches and show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers.
h1: An SEO and GEO agency for Dubai businesses that want to be the answer
intro: We help established Dubai businesses rank in Google for the searches that bring buyers, in English and Arabic, and show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers when people ask for a recommendation. The work covers technical fixes, Google Business Profile, content, outside mentions and monthly reporting tied to enquiries.

sections.h: Why Dubai search is harder than it looks
p: Search for an SEO company in Dubai and you will see dozens of agencies, directories and listicles fighting for one query. The same is true in almost every Dubai category worth having: property, clinics, restaurants, schools, movers. Long-standing local players hold the obvious terms, and Google is quick to bury thin pages that swap one area name for another.

On top of that, buyers are changing how they look. More of them now ask ChatGPT or Gemini for the best aesthetics clinic in Jumeirah or a reliable freight forwarder near Jebel Ali, and act on the short list they get back. Those answers draw on directories, reviews, comparison articles and pages that answer questions directly.

sections.h: What our SEO and generative engine optimisation (GEO) includes
list: Technical SEO: speed, crawling, indexing, structured data and clean language versions.
Local SEO and Google Business Profile for each real branch, clinic or outlet you operate.
Content that answers the questions Dubai buyers ask, area by area and service by service.
How your business is described across the web: directories, portals, review sites and comparison lists.
Answer-first pages that AI assistants can quote accurately.
Outside mentions from relevant UAE publications and industry sites.
Monthly reporting on rankings, AI answers, traffic and enquiries, not just positions.

p: Dubai buyers search in English, in Arabic and in a mix of both, and the results can differ a lot. We research both languages, set up hreflang correctly and give each language version its own titles and headings rather than a translated copy of the English. Arabic content comes from you or a translator you approve.

Area-level searches matter just as much. People look for services in Dubai Marina, JLT, Business Bay, Al Barsha or Mirdif, not just Dubai as a whole, so pages and profiles need to reflect the areas you actually serve.

sections.h: The Dubai search problems we fix most often
p: Much of what an SEO and GEO agency Dubai businesses hire ends up fixing is not glamorous. It is usually one of these:
list: An Arabic version that exists but is not indexed, or that Google treats as a duplicate of the English.
Branch listings with old phone numbers, closed locations or different names on every directory.
Property or product pages generated in bulk with almost no unique text, so none of them rank.
No page that answers the questions people actually ask, such as prices, areas covered or how booking works.
AI assistants describing the business from an outdated article or a competitor's comparison list.

sections.h: What SEO looks like for Dubai sectors
list: Real estate: community and project guides, off-plan explainers, and consistent profiles on the major property portals.
Clinics and aesthetics: treatment pages written within Dubai Health Authority advertising standards, practitioner credentials and reviews handled properly.
Hospitality: menus, offers and event pages that rank before the weekend, plus accurate listings on review and booking sites.
Retail and e-commerce: category pages, product data and marketplace presence that support each other.
B2B, logistics and DIFC firms: expertise content, clear service pages and listings on the directories buyers check before shortlisting.

p: Right now, 10 of the businesses we work with sit in Google's top five for their main searches and show up in ChatGPT's answers. We build Dubai work on the same method: fix the foundations, answer real questions clearly and make sure the rest of the web describes you consistently.

list: Talk: what you sell, where, to whom, and which searches would change your month.

sections.h: Working with a London search team
p: We serve Dubai businesses from London, on-site when the project needs it. Search work is almost entirely remote, and Gulf Standard Time being four hours ahead of London in winter, three in summer, keeps monthly reviews within both working days. We will need you for a few things only you can provide: access to Google Business Profile, photos of real premises, and staff who can answer specialist questions for content. Everything else, from fixes to outreach, we run ourselves, and each monthly review shows enquiries next to rankings so you can judge the work on what it brings in.

p: Look at a typical SEO and GEO agency Dubai shortlist and you will find firms that either chase rankings or talk about AI answers. We work on both, because Google and AI assistants increasingly reward the same thing: clear, accurate, well-cited information. We also run the website, paid media and video, so search findings turn into changes quickly. Related services include web development, paid media and AI automation.

faqs.q: What is GEO, and does a Dubai business need it?
faqs.a: GEO means making sure your business shows up correctly in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers. If your buyers ask an assistant for recommendations, and more of them do every year, it matters. It builds on solid SEO, so we treat the two as one programme rather than separate projects.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take in Dubai?
faqs.a: Technical fixes and Google Business Profile improvements usually show first. Ranking for competitive Dubai terms takes steady work, and takes longer in crowded categories like property or clinics. We set milestones in writing and report monthly, so you can see progress well before the hardest terms move.

Yes, on the technical and strategy side: Arabic keyword research, page structure, hreflang, titles and right-to-left setup. We do not claim in-house Arabic copywriters, so Arabic copy is written by you or a translator you approve, and we optimise and publish it.

faqs.q: Can you set up Google Business Profile for our Dubai branches?
faqs.a: Yes, for every location where you have real, staffed premises. We set up or clean up each profile, categories, services, photos and review handling, and keep the details consistent across directories. We will not create profiles for virtual addresses, because that breaks Google's guidelines and risks suspension.

faqs.q: How do you handle SEO for clinics under DHA rules?
faqs.a: We write treatment and practitioner pages within Dubai Health Authority advertising standards, which restrict claims such as promised outcomes and misleading before and after images. Content is reviewed by your medical team before publishing. The aim is pages that rank and help patients decide without exposing your licence to risk.

faqs.q: What makes a good SEO and GEO agency in Dubai?
faqs.a: Look for one that reports on enquiries, not only rankings, handles English and Arabic properly, and can explain what AI assistants currently say about you. Ask to see how they would fix your weakest page. A good SEO and GEO agency Dubai firms keep will give you a clear plan with dates.
